beats.sub: No RSS feed? Build one from your own audio files.

beats.head: Create a local feed.
beats.sub: A title and a slug. MinusPod serves it like any subscribed show.

beats.head: Your own show page.
beats.sub: Cover art, description and a feed URL for any podcast app, with the Local badge to tell it apart.

beats.head: Upload an episode.
beats.sub: One file at a time, or a bulk import with a dry-run preview first.

beats.head: Run it through the same pipeline.
beats.sub: Transcribe, detect, cut. Same pipeline as a subscribed feed, minus the stages that need an upstream.

beats.head: Watch it in the queue.
beats.sub: Until it finishes, the feed serves the original file so the archive is listenable right away.

beats.head: Ads found and cut.
beats.sub: Markers, chapters and transcript, exactly like a subscribed feed.

beats.head: It sits beside your subscriptions.
beats.sub: Exempt from retention cleanup, in the same podcast apps.
